trigger_phrases_or_events: input_boolean.alarm_primary_bedroom_ringing toggled on by an external (out-of-scope) alarm mechanism
execution_chain: 4-stage chain: Started (lamps+chime) -> Repeat (chime every 45s while ringing) -> Escalation (duck+play ambient audio after 2 min unacknowledged) -> Stop (restore audio) when turned off
functional_status: MAJOR-BROKEN (3 of 4 stages non-functional as wired)
household_outcome: Intended: bedside lamps turn on, a chime plays, repeats every 45s, escalates to ambient audio after 2 minutes if unacknowledged, and audio state is restored when silenced. ACTUAL: the lamp step (wrong script name), the escalation step (script does not exist at all), and the stop/restore step (script does not exist at all) all silently fail; only the chime-repeat step calls a script that exists, but that script's own audio-playback parameter is separately a no-op. Net effect: the input_boolean state machine runs correctly, but almost none of its intended audible/visual wake behavior actually occurs.
notes: SAFETY-RELEVANT FINDING — see production-gaps-and-owner-review.md for the explicit owner-verification request. The external mechanism that actually sets/clears input_boolean.alarm_primary_bedroom_ringing was not identified within the 26 in-scope automations or 44 in-scope scripts reviewed (likely a disabled/out-of-scope automation, a blueprint, or a third-party alarm-clock app/integration).
